title: Live Querybook: ad-hoc audit search, cursorless pagination, and schema-aware CSV/JSON exports
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Implement a 'Live Querybook' capability in the Audit Console that lets engineers and admins run ad-hoc searches, pin and share saved queries, and export results as schema-aware CSV or NDJSON. The feature must respect RBAC v2 row- and field-level redaction, support large-result streaming without requiring long-lived cursors on the frontend, and provide an optional scheduled export job interface for recurring deliveries to S3 or SFTP. This ticket covers backend export engine, console UX hooks, saved-query model, and basic telemetry for export health.
acceptance_criteria: Console users can run ad-hoc audit searches and immediately download results as CSV or NDJSON with the same RBAC redaction shown in the console.
Saved queries (Querybook entries) can be created, named, and shared within org with linkable IDs; permissions follow RBAC v2 project/team scoping.
Exports larger than 50k rows stream via server-sent NDJSON to avoid OOMs and do not require a client-side cursor token lifecycle.
Schema-aware CSV export includes stable column ordering and typing hints; nested objects are flattened using dot notation (e.g., session.user.email).

Scheduled exports can be created and will run as jobs via the Jobs Service; each scheduled run produces an object in customer-owned S3 or a temporary presigned download depending on customer settings.
Export telemetry (success/failure rates, runtime, bytes, rows exported) surfaces to the Console Export dashboard and raises alerts when export error rate > 1% over 1h.
Security review completed and any PII redaction configuration applied by default for enterprise orgs with data retention rules enabled.
E2E tests cover RBAC boundary cases: masked fields vs dropped rows, and full-text search filter serializations remain stable across versions.
technical_notes: Use time-window slicing + stable sort (timestamp, event_id) to implement cursorless pagination for export; this allows stateless workers to stream consistent slices without issuing monolithic queries.
Large exports stream NDJSON line-by-line from Export Service -> gzip -> object store / streaming response; for CSV, use a streaming serializer that respects quoting and typed columns.

Leverage RBAC v2 policy engine at the query planning stage to compute a projection and predicate for each request; apply field redaction at the serializer layer to guarantee consistency between console view and export.
Saved-query model: id, owner, org_scope, filters_json, last_run, shared_with (teams list); shareable links are permission-checked at access time.

Scheduled exports will create Export Job records and enqueue to jobs-service; include opt-in delivery adapters (S3, SFTP, presigned-download). Reuse existing jobs infra but add export-specific retry/backoff rules.
For very large result sets we will chunk slices into <=100MB gzipped files to avoid single-object limits and to improve resumability.
Integrate SSO/SAML session fields into export schema (saml_issuer, assertion_id) only if org consent allows; otherwise redact to comply with privacy settings.
Performance targets: first page download latency < 1s for <1k rows; streaming throughput >= 50MB/s aggregate across export workers for heavy workloads.
Security: export endpoints require admin or explicit export permission; audit an "export.created" event with job metadata and actor for every scheduled or ad-hoc export.
ux_notes: Add a 'Save as Querybook' button beside search box; saved queries have a small share dropdown to copy a link or grant access to a team.
Export modal should show estimated size (rows/MB) based on current filters and a warning if result set is >100k rows with option to schedule instead.
Progress UI for streaming exports: show running job with streamed bytes and rows; once complete, show a Download link or Delivery status.
Include a compact schema preview before export so users can choose which columns to include; defaults reflect RBAC projection.
Accessibility: ensure export modal and saved-query dialogs are keyboard and screen-reader friendly.

notes_summary: Feature implements ad-hoc and scheduled exports from Audit Console with RBAC-aware redaction, streaming NDJSON/CSV, saved queries, and schedule deliveries. Main blocker is Jobs Service auth; security review completed with conditions around sensitive session fields.
qa_checklist: Run export of 10k, 100k, and 1M rows in staging; verify streaming completes and file integrity (gzipped NDJSON/CSV).
Validate RBAC v2 redaction for three test roles: org-admin, team-audit, read-only-user.
Confirm saved-query share links respect permissions and expire tokens (if applicable).
Simulate scheduled export failures and verify retries and alerting fire as expected.
